scope: One requests implementation task, COMPACT and STRUCTURED; no Plan, attachments or examples

hardChecks: Compile the actual generated implementation and supplied test files together where applicable
Run authored tests and independent title/error/synthetic-credential checks with network disabled
Never repair missing code or infer credential safety from provider HTTP success
semanticChecks: Retain an executable implementation deliverable rather than only an implementation proposal
Preserve original action and target; do not invent project facts
Natural mode follows one verified twelve-core framework without forced four-module paragraph order
Both modes retain the same task and applicable rules

primaryComparison: RAW work versus each unchanged native-copy work under the same model and original information
dependencyFailurePolicy: No verified copy means dependent work and reviews are skipped; missing arms are never reconstructed.
